# Kanan Labs

> India-focused AI governance intelligence: publications, trackers and regulatory analysis.
> Site: https://kananlabs.in

## Publications

- [The State of AI Governance in India](https://kananlabs.in/publications/sample-publication/): India's AI governance remains fragmented: state initiatives outpace national frameworks, and sectoral rules for healthcare and finance are still emerging.

## Trackers

- [India AI Tracker](https://kananlabs.in/tracker.html): State-by-state tracking of AI policies, startups and infrastructure across India.
- [TradeWatch](https://kananlabs.in/tradewatch.html): Trade and technology intelligence.
